# The First Chapter {#sec-first}

<!-- TODO: TEMPLATE CONTENT. Replace this chapter with the author's text,

Each file in `chapters/` is one chapter, listed in `_quarto.yml`. The
`# Title` line names it, and `{#sec-first}` gives it an anchor that other
chapters can point to: see @sec-second.

## A section

Emphasis is *italic* and **bold**. A footnote goes here.[^first] A citation
looks like this [@strunk1918], and the reference list is generated. An
index entry\index{index entries} lands in the print index.

[^first]: Footnotes print at the foot of the page in the PDF and as
    pop-ups or end notes in the EPUB.

::: {.callout-note title="A callout"}
Callouts become shaded boxes in print and styled blocks in the EPUB and
on the web.
:::
